correctnessReview.observation: The pending ref locks synchronously before React rerenders. The complete accepted draft, including the next assistant question, is persisted immediately. Only presentation is delayed; reload during the pause retains both answer and next question.

Stable cleanup clears timeout and pending state. Account ownership changes, New ad, exit, and resumed/active run transitions cancel pending presentation. Unmount clears the timeout without a state update; the callback also checks owner and reply identity.

Pending delivery disables submission while keeping the textarea enabled. Duplicate Enter does not consume a second answer or clear newly typed text. Existing composition guards and focus behavior remain intact.

The hidden message and visible-last-message dependency are derived from pending presentation. User acceptance and assistant reveal each trigger the existing follow path. Explicit reading/scroll cancellation and tall review anchoring remain authoritative.
Accessible typing status occupies a neutral assistant bubble. Final review markup and reviewKey remain absent until reveal, and the generation guard independently rejects pending delivery.

Only initial intake answers enter the timer branch. Result revision replies remain immediate and continue to require explicit confirmation before paid work. Services, question text, provider code, approvals and allowance policy have no diff against the base.
